input.prompt: Routine health check of the dot-agent-deck website. Check whether requests to the website in the dot-agent-deck namespace are succeeding right now (the visitor workload logs the HTTP status of every request it makes). If they are healthy, reply only with "healthy" and stop. If they are not, investigate, fix it, verify, and report what failed, the root cause, evidence, timeline, the fix you applied, and how you verified it.
